English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #anurakumaradissanayake#dilithjayaweera#misleading Anura did not say no to a conversation with Dilith Misleading It was stated on the websites that Anura Kumara Dissanayake has refused the request of the leader of Mawbima Janata Party, Dilith Jayaweera, to the leader of the National People’s Power, Anura Kumara Dissanayake, to come to a live television conversation with him. by Anonymous | January 10, 2024 In this regard, the headline of the news published on the ‘Sathya’ website was, “Anura says no dialogue with Dilith”. It has also mentioned that Anura Kumara Dissanayake has rejected the challenge made by Dilith Jayaweera. Meanwhile, the ‘Lanka C News’ website had also published a news about this matter. They have also mentioned that Anura Kumara Dissanayake has rejected this challenge. Anura Kumara Dissanayake has made a statement in this regard by answering a question raised by the journalist during the live political conversation “Turning Point” which was aired on the “Siyatha” TV channel on the 8th (the day before). He said there, “මම එයාට කියන්නේ නගර සභාවට ඉල්ලලා මන්ත්‍රී ධූරයක්වත් අරන් එන්නකෝ අප්පා. මොනවද මේ කතා. ප්‍රාදේශීය සභාවක්වත් දිනලා එන්න කියන්න.” The video is here – https://youtu.be/XaOyYR35QMQ?t=5294 Also, when Fact seeker inquired about this from the media unit of the National People’s Power, they stated that Mr. Anura Kumara Dissanayake said that if you want to participate in the conversation, you should bring a councilor position in a municipal council or a local council. Accordingly, Fact Seeker confirms that the news that Anura Kumara Dissanayake refused to have conversation with Dilith Jayaweera is false.
